name: Tombstone RIP

features.name: xNudge wilds
features.description: Wilds nudge into view, raising their multiplier with each nudge.

features.name: Free spin modes
features.description: Several bonus modes with escalating multipliers.

review: Tombstone RIP pushed max-win marketing to an extreme with a 300,000x cap. The core of the game is xNudge wilds whose multipliers grow every time they nudge. It is a fascinating demo but one of the most volatile slots available, and the cap is a theoretical ceiling rather than a realistic target.
cons: One of the most volatile slots on the market
author: editorial-team
